title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1976-06-27
lineage: Master cassette audience> sony tc-755 reel w/teac an-180 dolby b (10.5" @ 7.5 ips); 1st generation reel play back on Technics RS-1506>Sony NR-335>Tascam HD-P2 24/48
source: 2 source matrix: Soundboard (shnid:112295) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF; Transfer Info: AIFF -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:98796) Source: audience 1st generation reel (Jerry Moore's reel)

ai_review.summary: A gorgeous matrix mix captures a smooth 1976 set highlighted by an outstanding Help‑Slip‑Franklin's sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its pristine, earthy matrix mix that showcases sweet tones from both Jerry’s Travis Bean and Bob’s Ibanez. The show itself is described as relaxed, polished and full of tight interplay, with the Help > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower standing out as a highlight. One listener noted an error in playback, but overall sentiment is highly positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews consistently rate the show around 4/5 and the matrix recording as exceptional (≈4.5/5); weighted combination yields ~4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the mix gorgeous, earthy yet pristine, with seamless AUD patches and crisp instrument separation; one comment mentions a playback error but does not detract from overall quality.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as dreamy, chilled‑out and polished, with tight interplay and smooth transitions—especially the seamless flow of Help into Slipknot! and onto Franklin's.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His Travis Bean guitar delivers a sweet "twang" tone praised by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s Ibanez produces a pleasant "clang" sound noted as sweeter than usual.
band_member_comments.Drums: The snare and bass are highlighted for their punchy, kicking feel; cymbal work described as intricate and in‑the‑pocket.
